issues.t: Intake manifold gasket coolant leak
issues.sym: Coolant level keeps dropping, a sweet smell after driving, coolant around the top or front of the engine, rising temperature gauge, or milky oil on the dipstick.
issues.why: The lower intake manifold gaskets on this V6 break down with age and heat and let coolant leak outside the engine or into the oil.
issues.next: Get it repaired soon instead of topping off and driving. Coolant mixing into the oil can wipe out the bearings, and overheating can warp the heads.

issues.t: Ignition can be bumped out of Run (recall 14V-400)
issues.sym: The engine suddenly shuts off while driving, often after the key or a heavy key ring gets bumped, and power steering and brake assist feel heavy.
issues.why: A heavy key ring or a knee bump can move the ignition key out of the Run position, which cuts the engine and can keep the airbags from deploying in a crash.
issues.next: Use only the ignition key on a light ring until the recall work is done. Check your VIN for open recall 14V-400 and get the free repair.

issues.t: Steering rack bearing retainer can fail (recall 03V-527)
issues.sym: Clunking from the steering, play or looseness in the wheel, or steering that does not respond the way it should.
issues.why: Retainer tabs that hold the pinion bearing inside the steering rack can break, which can affect steering control.
issues.next: Do not keep driving with loose or clunking steering. Check your VIN for recall 03V-527 and have the rack inspected.

issues.t: Passlock anti-theft no-start
issues.sym: The engine cranks but will not start, or starts and dies right away, and the security light is on or flashing. It may start after sitting a while.
issues.why: The Passlock sensor in the ignition lock housing can fail, so the computer thinks the car is being stolen and shuts off fuel.
issues.next: Leaving the key in On for about ten minutes may let the system relearn and get you home. A shop can test the sensor and ignition cylinder for a lasting fix.

issues.t: Accelerator pedal can stick in heat (recall 04V-528)
issues.sym: In hot weather the gas pedal is slow to come back up, so the engine keeps revving or the car does not slow down when you lift off.
issues.why: The accelerator pedal arm can bind in high temperatures and not return to idle.
issues.next: If the pedal sticks, shift to Neutral and brake firmly. Check your VIN for recall 04V-528 before driving the car normally again.

issues.t: Electric power steering assist cuts out (recalls 14V-153 and 15V-064)
issues.sym: The steering suddenly gets very heavy, often with a power steering warning message. It may come and go.
issues.why: The electric assist motor and its control parts in the steering column can fail, so you lose power assist. GM recalled these years and replaced the motor, column or control unit as needed.
issues.next: Grip the wheel firmly and pull over safely when it happens. Check your VIN for recalls 14V-153 and 15V-064 and get the free repair.

issues.t: Shift cable can break or come loose (recalls)
issues.sym: The gear shown on the shifter does not match the gear the car is actually in, or the car can roll after you put it in Park.
issues.why: The shift cable, its end tabs, or its retaining clip can crack or come off, so the transmission is not in the gear you selected. GM ran several recalls on these years.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake when you park. Check your VIN for recalls 14V-224, 12V-460 and 09V-073 and have the cable repaired.

issues.t: Brake lights and stability control fault from body module connector (recall 14V-252)
issues.sym: Brake lights stay off when braking or stay on when you are not braking, a stability control or traction warning appears, or cruise control will not engage.
issues.why: Corrosion and wear at a body control module connector raise electrical resistance, which can disrupt brake light and stability control signals.
issues.next: A car with no brake lights can be rear-ended, so get it checked right away. Check your VIN for recall 14V-252 and get the free repair.

issues.t: 6-speed automatic loses 3rd, 5th and Reverse
issues.sym: No reverse, the transmission skips or drops gears, harsh shifting, a flashing gear indicator, or a check engine light.
issues.why: A wave plate inside the 6-speed automatic can crack and break up, which takes out the clutch for 3rd, 5th and Reverse and sends debris through the unit. GM offered extended coverage on 2008-2009 models under bulletin 14404, which has since run out.
issues.next: Stop driving if the car has no reverse or is slipping badly, and have a transmission shop diagnose it. Repairing it early can keep debris from ruining the rest of the transmission.

issues.t: Oil burning and timing chain stretch
issues.sym: Needing to add oil between changes, a rattle at startup, rough idle or misfires, and a check engine light with cam or crank timing codes.
issues.why: Piston ring problems on this engine let it burn oil, and when the oil runs low the timing chain, guides and tensioner wear quickly. GM issued an oil consumption diagnostic bulletin for these cars.
issues.next: Check the oil every fill-up and never let it run low. Have a startup rattle or timing code checked quickly, because a chain that jumps can badly damage this engine.

issues.t: Low-beam headlights stop working
issues.sym: One or both low beams go out even with good bulbs, sometimes with a blown low-beam fuse.
issues.why: Shorts and corroded contacts in the headlight wiring harness can blow the fuse or cut power to the lamps.
issues.next: Have the wiring and fuse checked rather than just replacing bulbs. Use high beams carefully until it is fixed, since driving at night without low beams is unsafe.

issues.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall 19V-019)
issues.sym: There is usually no warning sign before a crash.
issues.why: The driver frontal airbag inflator can build too much pressure and burst when it deploys, throwing metal pieces into the cabin.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 19V-019 right away and get the free repair as soon as possible.

issues.t: Front seat belt anchor cable can break (recall 15V-269)
issues.sym: The seat belt anchor next to the seat looks frayed or separated, or the belt feels loose at the buckle side.
issues.why: Repeated bending as people get in and out can fatigue the steel cable that anchors the outboard belt, so it may not hold in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 15V-269 and get the free repair.

issues.t: Water pump leak or failure
issues.sym: Coolant leaking near the belt side of the engine, a low coolant warning, a sweet smell, noise from the pump at startup, or the temperature gauge climbing.
issues.why: The water pump on these engines can start leaking or wear out early. GM asked dealers for field information on noisy water pumps in an engineering bulletin.
issues.next: Watch the temperature gauge and pull over if it heads toward hot. Have a leak or noisy pump replaced before it causes overheating.

issues.t: Rear toe links can corrode and break (recalls 20V-764, 21V-633)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, the car pulling or feeling loose at the back, or uneven rear tire wear.
issues.why: Extra coating on the rear toe links can trap moisture, letting them corrode and possibly fracture, which affects how the car tracks.
issues.next: Do not ignore rear clunks or a wandering feel. Check your VIN for these recalls and get the free repair.

issues.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall 16V-502)
issues.sym: You can remove the key even though the shifter is not fully in Park, and the car may roll away after you walk off.
issues.why: A fault in the shifter and key interlock lets the key come out without the transmission being locked in Park.
issues.next: Always confirm Park and set the parking brake. Check your VIN for recall 16V-502 and get the free repair.

issues.t: Brake assist loss with auto stop/start (recall 14V-247)
issues.sym: The brake pedal feels hard and needs much more effort to stop the car, especially after the engine restarts from an auto stop.
issues.why: On the 2.5L with stop/start, the brake vacuum assist can be lost, so stopping distances get longer.
issues.next: Press the brake harder if needed and get it fixed right away. Check your VIN for recall 14V-247.

issues.t: Shift cable adjuster can disengage (recall 14V-092)
issues.sym: The shifter does not match the gear the car is in, or the car is not truly in Park when the shifter says it is.
issues.why: The shift cable adjuster can come apart from the shift lever, so the car may roll after being parked.
issues.next: Use the parking brake every time you park and check your VIN for recall 14V-092.

issues.t: Engine Power Reduced and loss of power
issues.sym: An Engine Power Reduced message, check engine light, sudden loss of acceleration, hesitation, or stalling while driving.
issues.why: Owners report faults in the electronic throttle and accelerator pedal sensor circuits that put the engine into a reduced-power mode. Many complaints for these years describe this.
issues.next: Get to a safe spot if power drops. Have the stored codes read and ask the dealer about updated software and related bulletins.

issues.t: Power loss and stalling in extreme cold (TSB 18-NA-069)
issues.sym: In very cold weather the car hesitates, loses power, may stall, and the check engine light comes on with boost codes.
issues.why: Moisture in the turbo charge air cooler can freeze and block airflow, and contamination can freeze in the wastegate control valve. GM issued a redesigned cooler, a software update and, on some years, a winter grille cover.
issues.next: Ask a dealer about bulletin 18-NA-069. After it warms up the car usually runs again, but get it checked before the next cold snap.

issues.t: Turbo wastegate rattle (PIP5418A)
issues.sym: A rattle from the turbocharger area, usually at idle or light throttle.
issues.why: GM issued a bulletin to help technicians trace a rattle to the turbocharger wastegate actuator rod.
issues.next: Mention bulletin PIP5418A to the dealer if you hear a rattle from the turbo area. It is a noise concern, but have it confirmed.

issues.t: "Shift to Park" message will not clear
issues.sym: After putting it in Park and shutting off, the car keeps saying Shift to Park and will not fully power down, which can drain the battery.
issues.why: A poor electrical connection between the shifter Park switch and the body control module. GM issued a bulletin that adds a wiring jumper and, if needed, replaces the shifter.
issues.next: Wiggling the shifter in Park may clear it for now. Ask a dealer about the Shift to Park bulletin for a permanent repair.

issues.t: ABS and stability control can shut off (recall 16V-272)
issues.sym: ABS and stability control warning lights come on, and anti-lock braking may not work.
issues.why: A memory chip in the brake control module can fail, disabling anti-lock brakes and stability control.
issues.next: Drive gently and leave extra stopping distance. Check your VIN for recall 16V-272 and get it fixed promptly.

issues.t: High-pressure fuel pump can come loose (recall 18V-358)
issues.sym: A fuel smell under the hood, a fuel leak, or the engine stalling.
issues.why: The engine-mounted high-pressure fuel pump can detach and damage the fuel line, which can leak fuel near hot parts.
issues.next: If you smell fuel, stop driving and have the car towed. Check your VIN for recall 18V-358.

issues.t: Passenger airbag sensor may be miscalibrated (recall 18V-400)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag status light shows the wrong state for who is in the seat, or an airbag warning light comes on.
issues.why: The front passenger presence sensor can be miscalibrated, so the passenger airbag may turn off when it should be on.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 18V-400 and get the free repair. Keep children in the back seat.

issues.t: Rear seat belt retractor fasteners loose (recall 21V-649)
issues.sym: A rattle from a rear seat belt retractor, or a rear belt that does not lock up properly.
issues.why: Fasteners holding the rear seat belt retractors may be loose or missing, so the belt may not restrain a passenger in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-649 and get the free repair.

issues.t: Software can shut off fuel injectors (recall 19V-642)
issues.sym: The engine suddenly loses power or stalls while driving.
issues.why: An error in the engine control software can disable the fuel injectors, cutting engine power.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 19V-642 and get the software update right away.

issues.t: Transmission fluid leak from stop/start accumulator (recall 20V-668)
issues.sym: Transmission fluid under the car, a burning smell, or the car will not move after an auto-stop.
issues.why: Bolts may be missing from the stop/start accumulator end cap, which can let fluid leak and cause a loss of drive or a fire risk.
issues.next: Stop driving if fluid is leaking or the car will not move. Check your VIN for recall 20V-668.

issues.t: Driver seat tilt weld may be weak (recall 22V-359)
issues.sym: The driver seat feels loose or moves when it should not.
issues.why: A weld in the driver seat cushion frame tilt mechanism may be weak, so the seat may not hold properly in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-359 and get the free repair.

issues.t: Front impact bar weld may be incomplete (recall 22V-923)
issues.sym: There is usually no sign while driving.
issues.why: The front impact bar may not be fully welded to the frame rail, which reduces crash protection.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-923 and get the free repair.

issues.t: Rearview camera picture distorted or blank (recall 26V-212)
issues.sym: The backup camera shows a distorted, frozen or blank image when you shift into Reverse.
issues.why: A fault can keep the rearview camera image from displaying correctly.
issues.next: Look carefully behind you when backing up and check your VIN for recall 26V-212.
